Description:
Enable diners to see live table availability on a 2D floor plan and reserve a specific table for a chosen slot without any risk of double booking.

Traces to: FR-001

Enable diners to browse the live menu and build a pre-order that is attached to their reservation and visible to the restaurant.

Traces to: FR-002

Time the kitchen work so that pre-ordered food is ready as the diner is seated, by computing cook-start times and releasing tickets to the KDS.

Traces to: FR-003

Take payment for the pre-order or deposit through a PCI-compliant gateway and confirm the booking to the diner, storing no raw card data.

Traces to: FR-004, NFR-002

Give the restaurant a truthful live floor plan: status changes synced in real time, no-show tables released, cancellations handled.

Traces to: FR-005, NFR-001

As a diner,
I want to see the restaurant's 2D floor plan with every table colour-coded as Available, Reserved or Seated,
So that I can see at a glance where I could sit before I commit to a booking.

Acceptance criteria: Floor plan renders in under 2 s; colours match live table state; tapping a table opens its details.
Traces to: FR-001 / UC-01

Summary: Story 1.2: Filter tables by slot and party size
Description:
As a diner,
I want to filter the floor plan by date, time slot and party size,
So that I only see tables that can actually seat my group at the time I want.

Acceptance criteria: Tables too small for the party size or already held for the window are shown as unavailable.
Traces to: FR-001 / UC-02

Summary: Story 1.3: Select and hold a table
Description:
As a diner,
I want to tap an available table and have it held for me for 10 minutes,
So that nobody else takes it while I finish choosing my food and paying.

Acceptance criteria: Hold expires automatically at 10 min and the table returns to Available; countdown visible to the diner.
Traces to: FR-001 / UC-01

As a restaurant manager,
I want the system to reject any second booking for a table whose dining window overlaps an existing one,
So that two parties are never sent to the same table.

Acceptance criteria: 0 double bookings across 100 simulated concurrent booking attempts on the same table.
Traces to: FR-001 / UC-02

As a diner,
I want to browse the restaurant's live menu by category with prices and prep time,
So that I can decide what to pre-order before I arrive.

Acceptance criteria: Menu reflects current availability; unavailable items are visibly disabled, not hidden.
Traces to: FR-002 / UC-03

Summary: Story 2.4: Show pre-order on the manager terminal
Description:
As a restaurant manager,
I want to see each booking's pre-order lines against its booking ID on my terminal,
So that the floor team knows what is coming before the diner walks in.

Acceptance criteria: Cart changes appear on the manager terminal within 2 s of being saved.
Traces to: FR-002 / UC-03

Summary: Story 2.2: Add items to the pre-order cart
Description:
As a diner,
I want to add menu items to a cart with quantity and customisation notes,
So that the kitchen prepares exactly what I asked for.

Acceptance criteria: Line total = unit price x quantity; customisation note stored with the line and shown on the ticket.
Traces to: FR-002 / UC-03

Summary: Story 2.3: Edit or remove cart items
Description:
As a diner,
I want to change quantities or remove items and see the total update immediately,
So that I can correct my order before paying.

Acceptance criteria: Total recalculates in the same screen refresh; cart cannot go below zero items.
Traces to: FR-002 / UC-03

As a diner,
I want the system to work out when each of my items must start cooking, from its prep duration and my arrival time,
So that my food is ready when I sit down rather than 20 minutes later.

Acceptance criteria: For a 19:30 booking with 10-min and 25-min items, cook-start times are 19:20 and 19:05 (± 1 min).
Traces to: FR-003 / UC-04

Summary: Story 4.1: Pay the pre-order through the gateway
Description:
As a diner,
I want to pay my pre-order amount or deposit inside the app,
So that my booking is confirmed and the kitchen can commit to preparing it.

Acceptance criteria: On authorisation the booking becomes CONFIRMED; on decline it stays PENDING and the hold is released after 2 failed attempts.
Traces to: FR-004 / UC-05

Summary: Story 4.2: Store payment tokens, never card data
Description:
As a restaurant owner,
I want card details captured by the gateway and kept only as a token, with TLS 1.2+ everywhere,
So that a breach of our database exposes no cardholder data.

Acceptance criteria: Scan of DB, logs and backups finds no PAN or CVV; endpoint scores A on a TLS configuration test.
Traces to: NFR-002 / UC-05

Summary: Story 4.3: Receive a digital confirmation with QR code
Description:
As a diner,
I want a confirmation with my booking ID, table number, itemised pre-order and a QR check-in code,
So that I can check in at the door without explaining my booking.

Acceptance criteria: Confirmation delivered by push and e-mail within 30 s of authorisation; QR scans successfully at the host stand.
Traces to: FR-004 / UC-05

As a restaurant manager,
I want to set and update the standard prep duration for every menu item,
So that the timeline reflects how my kitchen actually cooks.

Acceptance criteria: Duration changes take effect for bookings created after the change; existing tickets are unaffected.
Traces to: FR-003 / UC-04

Summary: Story 3.3: Release the ticket to the KDS on time
Description:
As a kitchen staff member,
I want the pre-order ticket to appear on the Kitchen Display System at the computed cook-start time,
So that I start each dish at the right moment without watching the clock.

Acceptance criteria: Dispatch timestamps written to the audit log; no ticket released more than 60 s early or late.
Traces to: FR-003 / UC-04

Summary: Story 3.4: See the estimated serve time
Description:
As a diner,
I want to see when my food is expected to reach the table,
So that I know what to expect before I confirm the booking.

Acceptance criteria: Estimate shown on the confirmation screen and recalculated if the cart changes.
Traces to: FR-003 / UC-04

As a diner,
I want to apply a promo code before the payment is authorised,
So that I get the discount I was offered.

Acceptance criteria: Valid code reduces the total before authorisation; invalid or expired code shows a reason and leaves the total unchanged.
Traces to: FR-004 / UC-06

Summary: Story 5.1: Update table status on the floor terminal
Description:
As a restaurant manager,
I want to move a table through Available, Reserved, Seated and Billed from my terminal,
So that the floor plan always shows the true state of my restaurant.

Acceptance criteria: Only valid transitions are offered; every change is written to the reservation history.
Traces to: FR-005 / UC-07

Summary: Story 5.2: Sync status changes in under 500 ms
Description:
As a restaurant manager,
I want a status change on one terminal to appear on every other terminal and on the diner app in under half a second,
So that two hosts never seat two parties at the same table.

Acceptance criteria: Benchmark at 200 concurrent sessions and 50 changes/min reports p95 ≤ 500 ms, p99 ≤ 800 ms.
Traces to: NFR-001 / UC-07

As a restaurant manager,
I want a reserved table to return to Available if the diner is not marked Seated within 15 minutes of the slot,
So that I can sell the cover to a walk-in instead of holding an empty table.

Acceptance criteria: Table released at slot + 15 min, booking flagged NO_SHOW, diner notified; grace period configurable.
Traces to: FR-005 / UC-08

As a diner,
I want to cancel my booking up to 60 minutes before the slot,
So that I am not charged for a meal I cannot attend and the table is freed.

Acceptance criteria: Cancellation before the cutoff releases the table immediately and triggers the refund rule; after the cutoff it is refused with the policy shown.
Traces to: FR-005 / UC-08
